question: The book 'Speaking Truth to Power: My Alternative View' is a collection of the following articles:
solution:
The correct answer is __P Chidambaram__ . 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• P Chidambaram is the author of the book 'Speaking Truth to Power: My Alternative View' . 
 
• P Chidambaram is an Indian politician and former lawyer , who currently works as a Rajya Sabha member.
 
• He served as the Chairman of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Home Affairs from 2017 to 2018 .
 
• Chidambaram has been the Union Finance Minister four times. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Arun Shourie is an Indian economist, journalist, author and politician. 
 
• Yashwant Sinha is an Indian administrator and politician.
 
• Mani Shankar Aiyar is an Indian politician and former career civil servant ambassador.
